        Commit message:
        SOLR-10639: Fix NPE in LRU/LFU/FastLRU caches toString method  
        
        Patch:
         
   @Override
   public String toString() {
-    return name() + cacheMap != null ? cacheMap.getValue().toString() : "";
+    return name() + (cacheMap != null ? cacheMap.getValue().toString() : "");
   }
